parsed.visual_overview: A continuous over-the-shoulder shot of a young Indian woman sitting in front of a large vertical screen on a balcony. The screen displays a white, humanoid AI robot face that she converses with. Text overlays pop up to highlight key phrases, corrections, and app UI elements.

characters.name: Priya
characters.brief: Young Indian woman seen from behind, wearing a black top with her hair in a bun.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.brief: White, humanoid robot face with bright blue eyes on a digital display.

scenes.scene_brief: Priya sits facing the large screen and makes a common English mistake, which the AI avatar gently corrects.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: How many brothers do you have?
Priya says: I am having two brothers.
Miss Nova says: (warmly) Not 'having'. Are you holding them in your hands right now? Say, 'I have two brothers'.
Priya says: Oh, okay, okay. I just freeze when I have to speak English.

scenes.scene_brief: The AI avatar addresses Priya's concerns about cost, bringing up the app's affordability and massive user base.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: That's okay! Have you tried practicing with an AI teacher?
Priya says: But wouldn't that be really expensive?
Miss Nova says: Not at all. Supernova AI is seven times cheaper than normal English classes. That's why over one crore people are practicing with it.
Priya says: But I really don't get time.

scenes.scene_brief: The AI avatar counters the time objection by explaining the quick, daily speaking practice method.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: Just 10 to 15 minutes a day is enough. No boring grammar rules, you just speak out loud, and I correct you without any judgment.
Priya says: Wow. How do I join?

scenes.scene_brief: The AI avatar delivers a direct call to action to download the app and start practicing immediately.
scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Click the install button and download Supernova AI right now. Sign up and start speaking with me today. You will see improvement in just 21 days. Come on, let's start!

pitch_points_used: Time is not the blocker (~10-15 mins a day)
